verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal, and its docs show `grep` in use (`help -l | grep command`), so it has some regex/filter text-search capability. It also bundles Vim for navigating files, though the evidence never describes Vim's search features or any code-search workflow. missing for 10: fuzzy matching (e.g. fzf), regex search across code content or project trees, code-aware navigation, any documentation of search features, independent corroboration.
